title: `CC <TAB>` resolves to a different match set: zsh inserts a unique match, zshrs lists directories

observed.fingerprint_label: cell/row0/col0 | ref/$ CC files | test/$ CC

observed.notes: zsh finds exactly one match ('files', the repo file of that name) and inserts it; zshrs finds the directories too and lists them. Run from the repo root — the match set is the working directory.
